steps.observation: Work on this for 10 seconds; do not stop early. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
Three major causes of World War I are:  
1. Militarism – the arms race and glorification of military power among European powers.  
2. Alliance systems – binding treaties (e.g. Triple Entente vs. Triple Alliance) that drew multiple nations into conflict.  
3. Imperialism – competition for colonies and global influence fueling international rivalries.
